name: search_docs
title: Search documents
description: Searches the documents the signed-in user is allowed to read. Returns up to 25 matches, each with its ID, title, a short plain-text excerpt and its source: internal, or external when the author is outside the organisation.

query.description: Words to look for in document titles and text.

name: get_doc
title: Get a document
description: Returns one document the signed-in user is allowed to read, by ID: its title, author, source (internal or external), last update date and plain-text body. Returns not_found if the document does not exist or the user may not read it.

id.description: A document ID returned by search_docs, such as doc-holiday-policy.
